description: Execute one reviewed granular capability as the connected user, including approval-gated actions.

account_id.description: Identifier of the connected provider account, from vault_services or vault_autonomy.

approval_id.description: Identifier of an owner approval already granted for this action, when the capability requires one.

capability_id.description: Identifier of the granular capability to execute, from vault_services.

params.description: Parameters for the capability, as defined by its schema in vault_services.

name: vault_execute
title: Use a granular connected-service capability
